premises.text: In spine surgery, surgeons cannot see screw paths inside vertebrae, and up to 23% of screws are malpositioned with paralysis risk
premises.evidence_span: up to 23% of all the screws placed during spine surgery are malpositioned, and in some cases, it can even make the patient paralyzed

premises.text: Current navigation projects guidance on a distant screen, forcing surgeons to look away from the patient at critical moments
premises.evidence_span: at the most critical moment, when the surgeon actually drills inside the vertebra, he needs to take his head off the patient and look aside on the distant screen to navigate

premises.text: Uncomfortable, non-intuitive navigation is why surgeons rarely use navigation systems
premises.evidence_span: All the current solutions for navigation are uncomfortable for the surgeons, they're not intuitive, and that is the reason why surgeons are not using navigation systems so often

premises.text: The visor projects patient anatomy in real time onto the surgeon's retina with surgical precision and strong depth perception
premises.evidence_span: we are able to project the patient anatomy in real time directly onto the surgeon's retina with surgical precision and with outstanding depth perception

premises.text: Workflow matches existing navigation: marker, pre-op scan, 3D CT model registered to the patient, with accurate tool tracking inside anatomy
premises.evidence_span: The workflow is the same as all other navigation systems

premises.text: Business model integrates the visor into existing surgical navigation and imaging systems via partnerships with global leaders
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is to integrate the visor into existing surgical navigation systems and medical imaging systems
